produced_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (AI draft, single pass) — NOT human gold

cells.value: 48 h average per 7 days, incl. overtime; reference period ≤4 months by default (agriculture may derogate up to 6, or 12 by collective agreement)
cells.quote: the average working time for each seven-day period, including overtime, does not exceed 48 hours
cells.translation: (English original)
cells.exceptions: Art 17(3)(c)(vii)/(d)(i) name agriculture for reference-period derogation; Art 19 caps it at 6 months (12 by agreement)
cells.notes: Directive = minimum; binds member states, not farms directly

cells.value: Normal 40 h/week; overtime ≤ average 8 h per 7 days over ≤4 months → max ≈48 h average incl. overtime
cells.quote: (5) Virsstundu darbs nedrīkst pārsniegt vidēji astoņas stundas septiņu dienu periodā, ko aprēķina pārskata periodā, kas nepārsniedz četrus mēnešus.
cells.translation: (5) Overtime may not exceed on average eight hours in a seven-day period, calculated over a reference period not exceeding four months.
cells.exceptions: 40 + 8 = 48 is a CALCULATION; summed working time (140. p.) and collective agreements not checked
cells.notes: likumi.lv is informative; official = Latvijas Vēstnesis

cells.value: 8 h per working day (Mon–Sat), extendable to 10 h if 6-month/24-week average ≤8 h → ≈48 h/week average
cells.quote: Die werktägliche Arbeitszeit der Arbeitnehmer darf acht Stunden nicht überschreiten. Sie kann auf bis zu zehn Stunden nur verlängert werden, wenn innerhalb von sechs Kalendermonaten oder innerhalb von 24 Wochen im Durchschnitt acht Stunden werktäglich nicht überschritten werden.
cells.translation: Employees' working time per working day may not exceed eight hours. It may be extended to up to ten hours only if an average of eight hours per working day is not exceeded within six calendar months or 24 weeks.
cells.exceptions: 48 h/week is an INTERPRETATION (6 Werktage × 8 h). ArbZG § 7 lets collective agreements deviate (not checked); Sunday work in agriculture § 10 (not checked)
cells.notes: GII text is non-official

cells.value: Max 12 h/shift, 60 h/week, average 48 h/week over 16 weeks (and 55 h average over 4 weeks)
cells.quote: a. 12 uren per dienst; b. 60 uren per week, en c. gemiddeld 48 uren per week in elke periode van 16 aaneengesloten weken.
cells.translation: a. 12 hours per shift; b. 60 hours per week, and c. on average 48 hours per week in every period of 16 consecutive weeks.
cells.exceptions: Lid 4: collective arrangement may deviate from lid 3
cells.notes: Fetched via KOOP open data, not wetten.overheid.nl (AI crawlers disallowed there)

cells.value: Max 48 h in any single week; average ≤44 h over any 12 consecutive weeks (general Labour Code)
cells.quote: Au cours d'une même semaine, la durée maximale hebdomadaire de travail est de quarante-huit heures.
cells.translation: During one week, the maximum weekly working time is forty-eight hours.
cells.exceptions: Agricultural employees have specific rules in the Code rural (L713-x) — NOT CHECKED; Légifrance blocks scripts (403)
cells.notes: Agriculture-specific answer may differ: trap for gold review

cells.value: Ordinary max 40 h/week average over the year; overtime ≤80 h/year
cells.quote: La duración máxima de la jornada ordinaria de trabajo será de cuarenta horas semanales de trabajo efectivo de promedio en cómputo anual.
cells.translation: The maximum ordinary working time shall be forty hours of effective work per week on average, calculated annually.
cells.exceptions: Art 35(2): overtime max 80 h/year (snapshot es_et_a35). RD 1561/1995 special working times in agriculture — NOT CHECKED. Collective agreements (convenios) set actual hours
cells.notes: BOE consolidated text is 'sin valor oficial'

cells.value: Ordinary 40 h/week; total working time ≤48 h average per 7 days over ≤4 months; general overtime ≤200 h/year
cells.quote: Den sammanlagda arbetstiden under varje period om sju dagar får uppgå till högst 48 timmar i genomsnitt under en beräkningsperiod om högst fyra månader.
cells.translation: Total working time in each seven-day period may amount to at most 48 hours on average over a reference period of at most four months.
cells.exceptions: The Act is largely dispositive: collective agreements may deviate (not checked)

cells.value: ≤48 h average per 7 days over ≤4 months; for agricultural workers a collective agreement may extend the period to 12 months
cells.quote: Käesoleva paragrahvi lõikes 1 nimetatud arvestusperioodi võib tervishoiu-, hoolekande-, põllumajandus-, teehoiu- ja turismitöötajatel kollektiivlepinguga pikendada kuni 12 kuuni.
cells.translation: The reference period in subsection 1 may be extended up to 12 months by collective agreement for health-care, welfare, AGRICULTURAL, road-maintenance and tourism workers.
cells.exceptions: § 46(1): 'Tööaeg kokku ei tohi ületada keskmiselt 48 tundi seitsmepäevase ajavahemiku kohta kuni neljakuulise arvestusperioodi jooksul'. A new TLS version starts 2027-01-01 (§ 46 wording unchanged in the parts checked)
cells.notes: Estonian consolidated texts are official

cells.value: Weekly time incl. overtime ≤48 h average in the reference period
cells.publisher: Kancelaria Sejmu (ELI API) — tekst jednolity Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1245
cells.quote: Tygodniowy czas pracy łącznie z godzinami nadliczbowymi nie może przekraczać przeciętnie 48 godzin w przyjętym okresie rozliczeniowym.
cells.translation: Weekly working time including overtime may not exceed an average of 48 hours in the adopted reference period.
cells.exceptions: Agriculture and animal husbandry: special rules for interrupted working time (Art 139 § 4) and overtime grounds (Art 151 list 'w rolnictwie i hodowli') — not fully checked
cells.notes: Official consolidated text (obwieszczenie) published 2026

cells.value: 48 h average per 7 days incl. overtime; reference period ≤4 months (collective agreements may extend)
cells.quote: La durata media dell'orario di lavoro non può in ogni caso superare, per ogni periodo di sette giorni, le quarantotto ore, comprese le ore di lavoro straordinario.
cells.translation: The average working time may in no case exceed forty-eight hours per seven-day period, including overtime.
cells.exceptions: Art 4(4): collective agreements may raise the reference period (to 6 or 12 months)
cells.notes: Agricultural CCNL not checked

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha/year from livestock manure (derogations possible)
cells.quote: The specified amount per hectare be the amount of manure containing 170 kg N.
cells.translation: (English original)
cells.exceptions: Derogations by Commission decision (e.g. NL until 2025)
cells.notes: Applies in nitrate-vulnerable zones / whole territory under action programme

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha/year from manure and digestate (= 1.7 livestock units)
cells.quote: ar kūtsmēsliem un fermentācijas atliekām iestrādātais slāpekļa daudzums vienā lauksaimniecībā izmantojamās zemes hektārā gadā nedrīkst pārsniegt 170 kilogramu, kas atbilst 1,7 dzīvnieku vienībām
cells.translation: the amount of nitrogen applied with manure and digestate per hectare of agricultural land per year may not exceed 170 kilograms, which corresponds to 1.7 livestock units
cells.exceptions: Point 3 applies to every operator (not only vulnerable zones) — INTERPRETATION from the lead-in sentence; digestate included (stricter than EU wording)

cells.value: 170 kg total N/ha/year farm average from organic/organic-mineral fertilisers (compost: 510 kg over 3 years)
cells.quote: 170 Kilogramm Gesamtstickstoff je Hektar und Jahr nicht überschreitet
cells.translation: does not exceed 170 kilograms of total nitrogen per hectare and year
cells.exceptions: Compost exception in the same paragraph; Länder 'red areas' rules (§ 13a) — not checked

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha from animal manure; no derogation from 2026
cells.quote: De gebruiksnorm voor dierlijke meststoffen, bedoeld in artikel 8, onderdeel a , is 170 kilogram stikstof per hectare van de tot het bedrijf behorende oppervlakte landbouwgrond.
cells.translation: The application standard for animal manure referred to in Article 8(a) is 170 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare of the farm's agricultural land.
cells.exceptions: Art 9(2) allows a higher norm by ministerial regulation (the former derogation route); RVO: no derogation in 2026

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha of utilised agricultural area per farm per year (vulnerable zones)
cells.quote: le passage de la limitation actuelle de 170 kg d'azote organique par hectare de surface épandable à 170 kg par hectare de surface agricole utile
cells.translation: the move from the current limit of 170 kg organic nitrogen per hectare of spreadable area to 170 kg per hectare of utilised agricultural area
cells.exceptions: Binding text (Code de l'environnement / arrêté) NOT retrieved: Légifrance blocks scripts; PISTE needs an account
cells.notes: SOURCE IS NOT THE LAW — a 2012 MP question describing it

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha/year from manure (210 kg allowed in first 4-year programme for newly designated zones)
cells.quote: La cantidad específica por hectárea será como máximo la cantidad de estiércol que contenga 170 kg/año de nitrógeno.
cells.translation: The specific amount per hectare shall be at most the amount of manure containing 170 kg/year of nitrogen.
cells.exceptions: Regional action programmes (autonomous communities) may be stricter

cells.value: 170 kg total N/ha/year from manure — but only inside designated 'sensitive areas'
cells.quote: Inom känsliga områden får stallgödsel inte tillföras i större mängd än vad som motsvarar 170 kg totalkväve per hektar spridnings areal och år.
cells.translation: Within sensitive areas, manure may not be applied in amounts exceeding the equivalent of 170 kg total nitrogen per hectare of spreading area per year.
cells.exceptions: Outside sensitive areas the main limit is phosphorus (22 kg P/ha/yr); a 2026 draft amendment is pending; later amendments after 2021 not checked
cells.notes: Note 'spridnings areal' contains a PDF line-break space

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha/year from manure on arable land, incl. grazing
cells.quote: Sõnnikuga on lubatud anda haritava maa ühe hektari kohta kuni 170 kilogrammi lämmastikku aastas, sealhulgas loomade karjatamisel maale jäävas sõnnikus sisalduv lämmastik.
cells.translation: Up to 170 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare of arable land per year may be applied with manure, including nitrogen in manure left on land during grazing.
cells.exceptions: § 161(2): extra rules outside the nitrate-sensitive area for maize/grassland

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha of agricultural land per year from natural fertilisers
cells.quote: zawierającej nie więcej niż 170 kg N w czystym składniku na 1 ha użytków rolnych
cells.translation: containing no more than 170 kg N (pure component) per 1 ha of agricultural land
cells.notes: PDF text extraction; check wording visually

cells.value: 170 kg N/ha/year in vulnerable zones (340 kg outside) — per secondary sources
cells.act: DM 25 febbraio 2016 n. 5046 (GU SG n. 90, 18.4.2016, SO 9) — NOT retrieved
cells.exceptions: Regional action programmes apply
cells.notes: FAILED: no official text retrievable by script (Normattiva/GU load text by JavaScript)

cells.value: No EU ban. Commission follow-up to 'Fur Free Europe' was due by March 2026; outcome not found
cells.quote: the Commission will communicate on the most appropriate follow-up action on the initiative by March 2026
cells.translation: (English original)
cells.notes: Absence of EU law = INTERPRETATION; whether anything was adopted after March 2026 is UNKNOWN

cells.value: Banned from 1 Jan 2028 (farm animals kept solely or mainly for fur)
cells.quote: Lauksaimniecības dzīvnieku audzēšana un turēšana ir aizliegta, ja audzēšanas vai turēšanas vienīgais vai galvenais nolūks ir kažokādu ieguve.
cells.translation: Breeding and keeping farm animals is prohibited if the sole or main purpose is obtaining fur.
cells.exceptions: Not yet in the current consolidated text (enters into force 2028); Constitutional Court upheld (2024, not re-read)
cells.notes: Trap: today's consolidated law does not show the ban text

cells.value: No explicit federal ban found; the fur-animal section of the farm-animal welfare ordinance is now 'weggefallen' (repealed)
cells.quote: Abschnitt 7 (weggefallen)
cells.translation: Section 7 (repealed)
cells.exceptions: That Abschnitt 7 was the fur-animal section is an ASSUMPTION; whether fur farming is de facto ended by earlier welfare rules is UNKNOWN
cells.notes: Needs human/expert check

cells.value: Banned: keeping, killing or having killed a fur animal is prohibited (mink phase-out was brought forward)
cells.quote: Het houden, doden of doen doden van een pelsdier is verboden.
cells.translation: Keeping, killing or having killed a fur animal is prohibited.
cells.exceptions: Art 1(e): 'pelsdier' = animal kept solely or mainly for its fur

cells.value: Banned: mink and other non-domestic species bred exclusively for fur (immediate, 2021 law)
cells.act: Code rural L214-9-1 (via Loi 2021-1539) — as described by the ministry
cells.quote: interdiction immédiate des élevages de visons et d’autres espèces animales non domestiques exclusivement élevés pour leur fourrure
cells.translation: immediate ban on mink farms and other non-domestic animal species bred exclusively for their fur
cells.exceptions: Domestic species (e.g. rabbits) not covered — INTERPRETATION; binding text not retrieved (Légifrance 403)
cells.notes: Guidance page, not the law

cells.value: No national ban found; the national animal-welfare law excludes production animals
cells.act: Ley 7/2023 de protección de los derechos y el bienestar de los animales
cells.quote: Los animales de producción, tal como se definen en la Ley 32/2007
cells.translation: Production animals, as defined in Law 32/2007
cells.exceptions: Regional initiative in Catalonia reported (news, not verified)
cells.notes: Proving absence needs a search log of BOE + regional gazettes

cells.value: Not banned; commercial fur breeding requires a permit
cells.quote: 3. föder upp pälsdjur.
cells.translation: 3. breeds fur animals. [permit required for anyone who professionally or on a larger scale … breeds fur animals]
cells.exceptions: Species-specific rules (e.g. foxes) in agency regulations — not checked; chapter number to confirm
cells.notes: Absence of ban = INTERPRETATION

cells.value: Banned from 1 Jan 2026: keeping, breeding and multiplying animals solely or mainly for fur
cells.quote: Keelatud on loomade pidamine, aretamine ja paljundamine üksnes või peamiselt karusnaha tootmise eesmärgil.
cells.translation: Keeping, breeding and multiplying animals solely or mainly for the purpose of fur production is prohibited.
cells.exceptions: Applies to animal keepers from 1 Jan 2026 (same section)

cells.value: Banned: commercial farming of fur animals except rabbits (Act of 7 Nov 2025, in force 19 Dec 2025); existing farms phase out (date not checked in text)
cells.act: Ustawa o zmianie ustawy o ochronie zwierząt
cells.quote: Zabrania się chowu lub hodowli w celach komercyjnych zwierząt futerkowych
cells.translation: Commercial rearing or breeding of fur animals is prohibited
cells.exceptions: Rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus) excepted; transitional end date for existing farms (2033 vs 2034 in secondary sources) NOT confirmed
cells.notes: Amending act; phase-out date must be read in its transitional provisions

cells.value: Banned from 1 Jan 2022 (mink, fox, raccoon dog, chinchilla, any species for fur); holdings to 30 Jun 2022 — per secondary sources
cells.act: Legge 30 dicembre 2021, n. 234, art. 1 commi 980–984 — NOT retrieved
cells.notes: FAILED: official text not retrievable by script
